name: Town of Memories
source:
What happens when you wake up alone in an unknown place where everyone around you seems like shadows - they're there, but not really there?
(Think the spirits in spirited away movie) You don't know what you're doing here, you don't have any memories either - heck, you don't even know your own name. Trying to escape, you run into a girl who is the self-proclaimed "keeper" of the town - what does that even mean, anyway? She claims that you need to undergo a series of tests to regain your memory and leave that place, but doesn't tell you anything more. Left with no choice, you have to go through a series of riddles and puzzles to regain your memory. Whether you leave that place or not depends on how well you do. Be careful! You don't want to irritate the keeper too much - like running away from her. Who knows what she might do to you, no?

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=33385]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
当你在一个未知的地方独自醒来，周围的每个人都像影子一样——他们在那里，但实际上并不在那里，会发生什么？
（想想千与千寻电影中的灵魂）你不知道你在这里做什么，你也没有任何记忆 - 哎呀，你甚至不知道自己的名字。试图逃跑时，你遇到了一个自称是小镇“守护者”的女孩 - 这到底意味着什么？她声称你需要接受一系列测试才能恢复记忆并离开那个地方，但没有告诉你更多信息。别无选择，你必须解决一系列谜语和谜题才能恢复记忆。你是否离开那个地方取决于你做得如何。当心！你不想太激怒守门员——比如逃离她。谁知道她会对你做什么，不是吗？

[来自[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=33385]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
